missions.name: Prologue
missions.notes: North Yankton heist/escape, playable as Michael Townley then Trevor. No gold-medal requirements per the dataset tips, so states favor safety over speed. Several steps (aim at hostages, phone detonate, take-out-the-guard QTE) are prompted contextually mid-cutscene rather than via a spatial objective_blip — treat mission.active=true with cutscene_active flickering as the cue to watch for a context prompt, not to navigate. The escape/farmhouse states are the highest fail-risk: crew death, losing the getaway car, or getting left behind all bust the mission per fail_conditions.

states.objective_text: Go to the guard (inside the depot)
states.visible_cues: mission.active=true, cutscene_active likely true at open, objective_blip appears on the guard ped inside the depot once control returns
states.expected_action: walk_to the objective_blip coordinates
states.success_signal: arriving near the guard triggers the hold-up cutscene / weapon-aim prompt
states.failure_signal: firing a weapon or alerting the guard before the cutscene triggers; leaving the depot
states.recovery: if StuckDetector fires near the door, issue a small unstick nudge and re-check objective_blip; do not free-roam wander here

states.objective_text: Aim your weapon at the hostages to make them move into the back room
states.visible_cues: no objective_blip — nearby.peds lists the hostages as neutral/compliant targets; a context prompt to aim appears once close
states.expected_action: No primitive can aim at a compliant ped to herd them. Best effort: walk_to the hostages' position and hold; if the scripted sequence advances the hostages on approach alone, that is the only path to progress. If it stalls, this state cannot be completed manually -- escalate to the recovery ladder (re-read objective, checkpoint retry) rather than repeatedly re-approaching.
states.success_signal: all hostages move into the back room and the game advances to the vault-detonation prompt
states.failure_signal: a hostage is shot, panics past the crew, or escapes
states.recovery: There is no re-aim action available. If TaskStallDetector fires here, escalate directly to the failure-recovery ladder rather than retrying an aim input that does not exist.
states.blocked_reason: No aim primitive exists -- herding hostages requires holding weapon-aim on a neutral/compliant ped, which is not in the action catalog. combat_hated_targets_around is explicitly the wrong tool (hostages are not hostile-flagged, so it would not even engage) and there is no other targeting primitive.

states.objective_text: Use your phone to detonate the explosive charge on the vault
states.visible_cues: no objective_blip, a phone/context-use prompt appears once hostages are clear
states.expected_action: use phone to trigger the charge
states.success_signal: vault door blows and the cash-collection prompt appears
states.failure_signal: detonating too early while a hostage or crew member is still in the blast area (scripted mission fails this itself if mistimed)
states.recovery: wait for the on-screen prompt rather than repeatedly retrying phone use

states.objective_text: Collect the cash from the vault
states.visible_cues: objective_blip/interact prompt on the vault cash bags
states.expected_action: walk_to the vault and interact to collect
states.success_signal: cash collected, cutscene of the guard grabbing Michael begins
states.failure_signal: leaving the vault room before collecting
states.recovery: none needed — short interact, but log if control_enabled goes false unexpectedly (cutscene starting)

states.objective_text: Take out the guard who grabs Michael
states.visible_cues: no objective_blip; nearby.peds flags the grabbing guard hostile, cutscene_active may toggle around the scripted grab
states.expected_action: combat_hated_targets_around focused on the single flagged hostile
states.success_signal: guard is downed and the mission proceeds to the police-arrival cover phase
states.failure_signal: Michael or Brad is killed during the struggle
states.recovery: ThreatLatch should keep aim locked on the one flagged hostile rather than idling

states.objective_text: Get to cover as police arrive
states.visible_cues: no objective_blip; wanted level rises, nearby.peds fills with hostile North Yankton PD
states.expected_action: seek_cover, then combat_hated_targets_around as police close in
states.success_signal: police wave suppressed enough for the crew to move to the shutter door
states.failure_signal: crew runs out of ammo, or Michael/Trevor/Brad is downed
states.recovery: DamageTracker + ThreatHold should keep the agent in cover rather than pushing into open ground

states.objective_text: Open the shutter door to reach the getaway car
states.visible_cues: objective_blip / interact prompt appears on the shutter mechanism once the firefight lulls
states.expected_action: walk_to and interact with the shutter control
states.success_signal: door opens, getaway car visible, crew moves toward it
states.failure_signal: getting pinned by police fire before reaching the door
states.recovery: if pinned, hold cover (do not abandon the shutter approach) until wanted/heat pressure eases

states.objective_text: Return to the crew
states.visible_cues: objective_blip on the getaway car / crew position beyond the shutter
states.expected_action: walk_to or drive_to the crew's position
states.success_signal: reaching the crew triggers the getaway drive
states.failure_signal: a crew member is left behind at the depot
states.recovery: none unusual; standard drive/walk-to logic

states.objective_text: Escape the cops through Ludendorff
states.visible_cues: route_blips laid along the escape road, wanted stars active, pursuing police vehicles in nearby.vehicles
states.expected_action: drive_to following route_blips, prioritizing distance from pursuers over fighting
states.success_signal: reaching the point where the freight train crash cutscene triggers
states.failure_signal: getaway car destroyed, stuck, or abandoned; a crew member left behind
states.recovery: StrandedEscalator if the car gets wedged; do not stop to fight pursuing cops

states.objective_text: Get to the car after the train crash
states.visible_cues: objective_blip on the replacement/continuing vehicle near the wreck
states.expected_action: walk_to the marked car
states.success_signal: entering the car advances to the regroup wait
states.failure_signal: wandering away from the wreck site instead of following the marker
states.recovery: none unusual

states.objective_text: Wait for the crew to regroup
states.visible_cues: no objective_blip; cutscene_active or a stationary hold with crew NPCs converging in nearby.peds
states.expected_action: hold position near the car, do not wander
states.success_signal: crew boards / cutscene advances to the drive segment
states.failure_signal: walking off before the crew arrives, or attacking during the wait
states.recovery: Pure wait state — TaskStallDetector's free-roam-search behavior must not trigger here; treat as expected idle for up to max_wait_s. If the crew has not boarded and the scene has not advanced to the drive segment after max_wait_s, re-read objective_text and nearby.peds for the crew's actual positions, try one small reposition back to the car in case you drifted from the pickup point, then hand off to the graduated recovery ladder (failure_recovery) — do not keep holding indefinitely.

states.objective_text: Drive to the helicopter pick-up point
states.visible_cues: objective_blip / route_blips toward the helicopter LZ
states.expected_action: drive_to the blip
states.success_signal: reaching the LZ area triggers the route-blocked cutscene
states.failure_signal: car destroyed or stuck en route
states.recovery: standard drive_to recovery (unstick, re-route)

states.objective_text: Get back in the car when the route is blocked
states.visible_cues: objective_blip re-appears on the car after a forced on-foot detour
states.expected_action: walk_to and enter the vehicle again
states.success_signal: back in the car, mission proceeds to the farmhouse standoff
states.failure_signal: leaving the immediate area on foot instead of re-entering the car
states.recovery: none unusual

states.objective_text: Hold off the cops at the farmhouse until the sequence ends
states.visible_cues: no objective_blip; sustained hostile peds/vehicles converging, sniper fire per tips — use available cover objects
states.expected_action: seek_cover then combat_hated_targets_around in waves until the scripted sequence resolves
states.success_signal: sequence auto-resolves into the Prologue's closing cutscene (Michael appearing to die)
states.failure_signal: Trevor, Brad, or Michael killed; running out of ammo mid-firefight
states.recovery: DamageTracker + ThreatLatch keep the agent in cover; this is a defend-in-place state, not a navigation one

missions.name: Franklin and Lamar
missions.notes: Grounded entirely in the existing dataset (9 objectives, well-detailed). The follow-Lamar getaway-route step is the mission explicitly cited in the task prompt as the source of the real 'Franklin lost Lamar' failure — marked has_marker:false, kind:follow; Lamar's car is only a radar blip during the chase, no ground waypoint. The 'get back in car after an obstacle' objective is compressed in the source data (likely a scripted knockdown/obstacle moment in the movie-backlot chase); modeled generically as a recovery/interact beat since exact trigger wasn't independently verified.

states.visible_cues: Two nearby enterable vehicles; Lamar standing between them; no map waypoint yet
states.expected_action: enter_nearest_vehicle on either car
states.success_signal: Franklin is driving; short dialogue starts, Lamar takes the other car
states.failure_signal: none — this step cannot fail

states.success_signal: distance to Lamar stays close and stable until the route opens into the next beat
states.failure_signal: distance to Lamar's blip grows steadily (falling behind/lost) risking a 'lost Lamar' fail, or the car takes heavy prop-collision damage
states.recovery: if separated, wander_drive toward Lamar's last known blip heading and take the same road he took rather than a shortcut; slow down through obstacle zones

states.objective_text: Get back in the car after an obstacle knocks Franklin out or blocks the road
states.visible_cues: Franklin on foot near a blocked/exited vehicle, no HUD marker beyond the vehicle re-entry icon
states.expected_action: enter_nearest_vehicle immediately, then resume following
states.success_signal: Franklin is back in a drivable car and moving again
states.failure_signal: prolonged delay lets Lamar/pursuers get far ahead, or the car is abandoned too long
states.recovery: re-enter the nearest usable vehicle and accelerate to catch back up to Lamar's blip

states.objective_text: Park next to Lamar

states.expected_action: drive_to the marker beside Lamar's car and stop
states.success_signal: Franklin's car comes to rest next to Lamar's; dialogue triggers
states.failure_signal: parking too far away or driving off leaves the objective unmet
states.recovery: drive_to the marker/blip location and stop

states.visible_cues: Wanted stars on HUD, police vehicles pursuing; no ground marker — objective is the wanted meter itself
states.expected_action: flee_police — break line of sight, use side streets, avoid further collisions
states.success_signal: wanted stars fade to zero
states.failure_signal: busted or wasted
states.recovery: flee_police toward cover (tunnels, alleys) until stars clear, then resume the route

states.objective_text: Take the repossessed car back to the dealership
states.visible_cues: Map waypoint on the dealership; car must stay undamaged for gold
states.expected_action: drive_to(dealership marker), drive carefully
states.success_signal: arrival at the marker triggers the handoff cutscene with Simeon/Jimmy
states.failure_signal: car destroyed/abandoned before arrival, or damage sustained en route jeopardizes delivery

states.objective_text: Get in your own car (the Buffalo S given by Simeon)
states.visible_cues: New vehicle marker/blip at the dealership lot
states.expected_action: enter_nearest_vehicle on the marked car
states.success_signal: Franklin is now driving his own car
states.failure_signal: none expected
states.recovery: walk_to the marked vehicle and enter it

states.objective_text: Go to Franklin's house
states.visible_cues: Waypoint marker on the map leading to Franklin's home
states.expected_action: drive_to(house marker)
states.success_signal: arrival triggers the mission-complete/end cutscene
states.failure_signal: wasted/busted en route (low-threat drive)

No hard timer; the two real risks are (1) losing/failing to progress through the marker-less follow segment at repo_s3 (the agent has previously idled here waiting for a marker that never appears — do not wait, walk toward Lamar's on-screen position), and (2) letting the target Bagger motorcycle get destroyed at any point after it's found. Combat states show hostiles as red radar blips rather than a waypoint, which is treated as has_marker:true (target visibility) distinct from a location waypoint.

states.expected_action: enter_nearest_vehicle(bike)
states.success_signal: Franklin is mounted and mobile on the bike

missions.name: Complications
missions.notes: Source dataset objectives 5 and 8 ('take the car to the dealership' and 'return to the dealership before police arrive') appear to describe the same drive rather than two separate trips — GTA V's actual mission is a single direct drive from the house to Premium Deluxe with Michael hiding inside; I modeled s8 as a duplicate/urgency restatement of s5 rather than inventing a distinct later drive. The garden-wall entry point (climbing the gardener's truck) has no map marker in-game — it's an environmental find, not a navigation objective, so has_marker is false there even though the house itself is marked.

states.objective_text: Go to the house (De Santa residence, Rockford Hills) to repossess the SUV
states.visible_cues: yellow objective blip on minimap/GPS route line over the house
states.expected_action: drive_to the house marker
states.success_signal: player enters the trigger radius around the house; objective text updates to finding a way in
states.failure_signal: player ignores the blip for a long time (no hard fail, just delay)
states.recovery: re-check GPS and drive_to the house marker again

states.objective_text: Find a way into the house (scale the wall/garden via the gardener's truck)
states.visible_cues: no map marker on the climb point itself; a contextual climb/jump prompt appears near the gardener's truck against the wall

states.success_signal: player is now inside the garden compound and the next objective (take out the gardener) appears
states.failure_signal: player wanders the perimeter without finding the truck/climb point, wasting time (no hard fail)
states.recovery: walk the wall line looking for the parked truck referenced in tips; try climbing near it

states.objective_text: Take out the gardener
states.visible_cues: a single hostile-tagged ped working in the yard, unmarked on the map; no alarm meter shown but nearby residents can be alerted by noise
states.expected_action: approach unseen from behind and use the contextual takedown prompt (press_prompt_key) if one appears -- there is no sustained melee-attack primitive, only a single context-prompt press. Avoid combat_hated_targets_around here; gunfire alerts the household.
states.success_signal: gardener is down/unconscious and the household inside remains unaware
states.failure_signal: gunfire or a loud struggle alerts the family inside, escalating the encounter
states.recovery: if already alerted, push into the garage quickly before more residents react

states.objective_text: Retrieve the car from the garage
states.visible_cues: the yellow Karin BeeJay XL SUV is highlighted/marked once inside the garage
states.expected_action: enter_nearest_vehicle on the marked SUV
states.success_signal: player is now driving the SUV and Michael's hidden-passenger dialogue triggers
states.failure_signal: entering the wrong vehicle, or damaging/losing the marked SUV before leaving
states.recovery: return to the garage and enter the correct marked SUV

states.objective_text: Take the car to the dealership without deviating (Michael is hiding inside)
states.visible_cues: GPS route line drawn directly to Premium Deluxe Motorsport; Michael's dialogue plays from the hidden compartment; wanted stars would appear on HUD if spotted by cops
states.expected_action: drive_to the dealership marker, staying on the direct route and avoiding collisions/cops
states.success_signal: SUV arrives at the dealership marker with Michael still aboard and no wanted level
states.failure_signal: a long detour off the GPS route, heavy vehicle damage, or a wanted level leading to a bust
states.recovery: get back on the GPS route immediately; if wanted, break line of sight (flee_police) before resuming drive_to

states.objective_text: Ram the car through the dealership window
states.visible_cues: the dealership storefront glass is the marked destination point; cutscene camera cues trigger as the car nears the window
states.expected_action: drive_to straight at the marked window at speed to trigger the scripted crash
states.success_signal: cutscene plays of the SUV smashing into the showroom; confrontation with Simeon begins
states.failure_signal: stopping short of or veering away from the window, failing to trigger the cutscene
states.recovery: reposition facing the marked window and drive straight in

states.objective_text: Beat up Simeon
states.visible_cues: on-screen attack prompt during a contained scripted brawl; no map marker since this isn't a navigation objective
states.expected_action: hold position near Simeon -- there is no primitive to throw repeated punches or sustain a brawl. This state cannot be executed as written; wait a bounded period in case a single contextual prompt resolves it, otherwise escalate to the recovery ladder.
states.success_signal: Simeon is beaten down and the confrontation cutscene resolves
states.failure_signal: letting Simeon land repeated counter-hits (not a hard fail, just a worse/slower outcome)
states.recovery: No sustained melee-attack primitive exists; do not loop pressing an attack input that isn't available -- escalate to the recovery ladder rather than waiting indefinitely.
states.blocked_reason: No repeated melee-attack primitive exists -- press_prompt_key presses one contextual prompt only and cannot sustain an attack sequence against an actively resisting NPC.

states.objective_text: Return to the dealership before the police arrive
states.visible_cues: likely the same GPS/urgency framing as s5 rather than a distinct later trip — see mission notes
states.expected_action: treat as identical to s5's drive_to objective if it recurs; otherwise this resolves automatically once s6-s7 complete
states.success_signal: mission-complete screen, cash/RP awarded
states.failure_signal: none beyond the drive fail conditions already covered in s5 (wanted level, car destroyed)
states.recovery: if treated as a separate beat, drive_to the dealership marker again avoiding cops

missions.name: Father/Son
missions.notes: Two-protagonist mission with scripted switches between Michael and Franklin. Amanda's Sentinel must survive undamaged for the 'Not a Scratch' gold, so treat any drive step as damage-sensitive. The catch-Jimmy beat is a positioning + timed prompt, not a normal marker walk, and 'reunite with Franklin' has no marker at all — it's a blip-only rendezvous, exactly the kind of state that has previously caused 'Franklin lost' failures elsewhere in this dataset. Sourced entirely from the existing dataset (already cross-checked gta.wiki + gtabase.com at extraction time).
